twin.title: Your field in 3D
twin.demo: No field is selected, so this shows a demo field. Draw your own on the map to see it here.
twin.error: The 3D view could not start on this device. The flat outline of the field is shown instead.
twin.exaggeration.label: Terrain height
twin.exaggeration.hint: Stretches hills and valleys so gentle slopes are easier to see.
twin.camera.label: Camera
twin.status.globe: Starting from space and flying to your field.
twin.fallback.title: Flat view of your field
twin.fallback.body: This browser cannot draw the 3D view, so here is the outline of the field. A newer browser, or turning on hardware acceleration, shows the terrain.
twin.fallback.outline: Outline of the field, north is up
twin.lapse.title: Time-lapse
twin.lapse.none: This field has no satellite frames yet, so the terrain is shown without them.
twin.lapse.error: The satellite frames could not be loaded: {message}
twin.lapse.ndvi.caption: Greenness seen from space: brown is bare soil, green is a healthy crop.
twin.lapse.moisture.caption: A translucent blue layer: the darker the blue, the wetter the soil.
twin.lapse.replay.on: Playing only the season of the Season Replay: {season}.
twin.lapse.replay.none: Open a season in the comparison's Season Replay to use this.
twin.lapse.replay.empty: No satellite frames fall inside the season {season}.
